mapper.select: SELECT pro.id, pro.code, pro.purchase_order_code, pro.supplier_name, pro.approve_status, pro.invalid_status, prod.sku_no, pro.bill_date, pro.return_warehouse_name, prod.return_qty, pro.return_remark, pro.return_mode, pro.purchase_user_id, pro.return_user_name, prod.remark, pro.approve_user_name, pro.create_user_name, pro.create_time, prod.purchase_order_detail_id FROM po_return_detail prod LEFT JOIN po_return pro ON prod.main_id = pro.id AND prod.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pro.is_deleted = FALSE AND pro.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}

select pr.supplier_id,count(distinct pr.id) as qc_return_count,sum(prd.return_qty) as qc_return_qty from po_return pr inner join po_return_detail prd on prd.main_id = pr.id where pr.approve_status = 'approve' and pr.is_deleted = false
and pr.supplier_id in
#{item}
and pr.source_type in
#{item}
AND pr.bill_date >= #{params.dateList[0]} AND (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > pr.bill_date
group by pr.supplier_id
